messages:
marta: dropped a new mini-legend + scrubber prototype for the rollout timeline (Figma link: https://figma.com/file/miniLegend789). Objective: make multi-variant A/B and canary stacks readable at glance while keeping the page height minimal.
jamal: nice. first pass notes: the stacked variant bars are tight — need distinct non-color cues for each variant. propose micro-patterns (dots/stripes) and 1-letter visible badges (A/B/C) overlay. also ensure the legend is keyboard reachable.
rebecca: agree on patterns. copy note: the quick action in the row currently says "Promote" for moving canary to 100% — maybe "Promote to primary" is clearer. and for rollback replace scary single word with "Revert to previous release" and add short consequence line in the modal.
chris: accessibility: scrubber keyboard left/right should move selection by logical steps (prev/next version), shift+arrow for +/-10%. When selection changes, announce via ARIA live: "Selected v3.1.0 — canary 20% — deployed 3h ago". Also focus order: legend before scrubber.
marta: about the tiny percent chip over bars — on dark theme it loses contrast. options: add semi-opaque pill backing or show plain text next to the stack on narrow widths. let's test both.
jamal: inline diff proposal: clicking the delta chevron opens an inline panel anchored to the row (not full modal). must set aria-expanded on the trigger and focus the panel. Esc closes and returns focus to the chevron. panel should include a small "Copy config" action.
rebecca: diff CTA copy: "View config & env changes" (short). in the rollback modal body: "This will route new traffic to vX.Y.Z. Existing requests may be interrupted. Undo available for 5 minutes." Put the undo note in muted text under primary action.
design-bot: Accessibility checklist: visible focus styles, ARIA live region for scrubber, aria-valuemin/max/now for percent control, color+pattern indicators, contrast >=4.5:1 for critical text, descriptive labels for icons.
marta: action items: 1) add patterns + A/B/C badges to stacks (jamal) 2) update promote/rollback copy + undo microcopy (rebecca) 3) keyboard scrubber steps + ARIA live (chris) 4) prototype inline diff panel + focus handling (marta). I'll post updated frames tomorrow morning and tag each of you.
jamal: one more nit — legend should include a small keyboard hint: "Tab to legend + Enter to toggle" for power users.
rebecca: ok to add an abbreviated legend teaser on collapsed state (icon + "A/B") so people know there's more.
marta: noted. thanks team — will iterate and follow up. :sparkles:
